    - Start and end with an alphanumeric character
    - Be at most 253 characters (though we don't enforce this limit here)

    # Convert to lowercase
    sanitized = name.lower()
    
    # Replace spaces and invalid characters with hyphens
    # Keep only alphanumeric, hyphens, and dots
    sanitized = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\-\.]', '-', sanitized)
    
    # Replace multiple consecutive hyphens with single hyphen
    sanitized = re.sub(r'-+', '-', sanitized)
    
    # Remove leading/trailing hyphens and dots
    sanitized = sanitized.strip('-.')
    
    # If the result is empty or starts with invalid character, prepend 'dataset'
    if not sanitized or sanitized[0] not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789':
        sanitized = 'dataset-' + sanitized
    
    # If still empty or ends with invalid character, append 'name'  
    if not sanitized or sanitized[-1] not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789':
        sanitized = sanitized + 'name'
